jobs.employer_name: YOUNG UNIVERSITIES FOR THE FUTURE OF EUROPE (YUFE)
jobs.description:
What you will be working on

The YUFE Alliance is looking for a motivated Communications and Monitoring Officer that will have the opportunity to:

• Take part in the daily operations of the YUFE Central Office in Brussels
• Manage and maintain the website, including content development, monitoring and contact with web developers
• Coordinate the implementation of the YUFE seed funding, including communication and dissemination, support to applicants, selection process and committee, as well as follow-up and iteration of the scheme
• Keep up to date the contact database and distribution lists for YUFE communications
• Support market analysis on our joint educational offers 
• Support our communications content planning, delivery, monitoring and reporting
• Assist in the planning and execution of meetings and events
• Assist in project management tasks such as reporting and dissemination 
What we are looking for

We are looking for a dedicated, proactive team player that wants to contribute to a dynamic team within an international and intercultural environment. As equity, diversity and inclusivity belong to YUFE's core values, we are searching for a colleague fully committed to these principles.

• Ideal start date: January 2027
• You hold a master's degree
• At least 3 years of working experience in a Communications/Dissemination based role or similar
• Good knowledge of MS Office package (experience with SharePoint and Exact Online), Mailchimp, Canva, WordPress, experience with CornerStone is an asset
• You are strong at planning and organisation 
• You have excellent written and oral communication skills in English (any other European language will be an asset)
• You feel at ease to work independently, within a small team and are flexible to support a diverse range of tasks 
What we are offering 

• A contract of indefinite duration (under Belgian law)
• Salary based on experience (and orientated on salary scales of Belgian Universities)
• Competitive package of benefits (meal vouchers, full reimbursement of public transport, group insurance, etc.) 
• An open working environment with attention to your work-life balance and up to 40 days of holidays
• The possibility of working from home two days a week 
• Broadening of your professional networks in Brussels and across the EU

STRATEGY & CEO SUPPORT

¿ Support key decisions with analyses and business cases¿ Turn priorities into action plans and drive them across departments¿ Lead cross-functional projects and external partners¿ Spot growth and efficiency opportunities

RETAIL EXPANSION

¿ Identify and analyze locations for new ateliers¿ Build business cases on sales potential, investment and returns¿ Manage real-estate agents, landlords and partners¿ Run the process from screening to investment decision and budgeting

STRATEGIC & OPERATIONAL PROJECTS

¿ Lead operational improvement projects with production¿ Support new channels and partnerships, from delivery platforms to a franchise model¿ Renegotiate supplier contracts and support strategic procurement

PROCESS OPTIMIZATION, AI & AUTOMATION

¿ Find inefficient processes and help teams automate them¿ Use AI and digital tools to sharpen analyses and productivity¿ Build practical AI use cases across departments with IT

GROWTH & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

¿ Analyze new growth opportunities¿ Support strategic B2B opportunities and major accounts, including pricing analyses¿ Track initiatives and recommend corrective action

 
 
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

¿ 1-3 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking or private equity¿ Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills¿ Highly proficient with AI tools and how automation improves processes¿ Strong project management skills; able to coordinate stakeholders without hierarchical authority¿ Strong ownership: you make sure things get done¿ Entrepreneurial, at ease between strategy and execution¿ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills¿ Fluent in French, Dutch and English
 
WHAT WE OFFER

¿ A seat next to the CEO, at the heart of the biggest decisions¿ Broad exposure to growing an ambitious Belgian SME¿ A versatile role across strategy, finance, operations and development¿ Real autonomy and responsibility from day one¿ Speed, entrepreneurship and a product to be proud of¿ A people-first culture: care, accountability, collaboration¿ Strong growth opportunities¿ A competitive compensation package

Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven  #Talent  Purpose:  Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive.  We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy.  We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work.  That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT.  Internship description:  The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation.  What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners   
Internship duration:  Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.   Work environment  Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation:  Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University.  
 
 
Why build your career with us:  We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.  UNIQUE CULTURE  We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.   BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.  GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth.  If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.   

#LI-ABI ZoneEUR

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

• 
Trilingual: Fluent in English, Dutch, and French (essential! ). 
• 
Skilled and Professional: Strong administrative, linguistic, and interpersonal abilities. 
• 
Self-starter: Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks. 
• 
Well-presented: Classic, professional attire required (no casual wear). 
• 
Reliable and Organized: Punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive. 
Your Responsibilities: 
You are entrusted with overseeing daily operations and ensuring the smooth running of our services. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: 
• 
Welcoming and assisting clients, visitors, and suppliers (EN/NL/FR). 
• 
Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR). 
• 
Office Operations: Handling incoming and outgoing mails/packages, filing, data input, and client file management. 
• 
Client Support: Coordinating meeting room and event requests, arranging lunches, and preparing new client offices. 
• 
Problem-Solving: Addressing customer requests, issues, and complaints promptly and professionally. 
• 
KYC – Handling client files in accordance with our obligations under anti-money laundering regulations. 
• 
Administration and Commercial Support: Control, update, and complete client files/data. Process new requests, conduct visits, and be the key to successful new collaborations through meticulous commercial support. 
• 
Facility Oversight: Performing daily checks of common areas, ensuring a tidy and functional workspace, managing stock, and handling kitchen appliances. 
• 
Administrative Reporting: Providing regular reports to management and overseeing office supplies and operations.

- Language, administrative, and interpersonal skills are essential. 
- Computer proficiency: Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.). 
- Multitasking ability: You manage responsibilities efficiently and gracefully. 
- Team player mentality: Though you work independently, you enjoy regular contact with clients and colleagues. 
- Professional ethics: You respect the company, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate appropriate behavior toward colleagues, management, clients, and partners. You know where the boundaries lie.
 

- Commitment: Understanding the responsibilities and requirements associated with a small organisation in a competitive sector.
 

- Punctuality
 

- Working remotely is not possible for this position.
 

- Dress code in line with the neutrality policy – classic and professional attire.

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling.The Configuration & Marshalling Team Leader ensures effective preparation, coordination, and follow-up of the team's activities in compliance with company standards and procedures. The role involves allocating work according to weekly objectives and priorities set by the Completion Manager, while also actively participating in daily operational activities and supporting the team when required.

Your role:Reporting to the Completion Manager your main tasks and responsibilities are:Team Management:

• Lead and coordinate daily team activities
• Identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions
• Allocate resources based on priorities and objectives
• Monitor skills and ensure development plans
• Ensure compliance with quality standards and company rules
• Manage shift handovers
Daily Operations:

• Perform configuration and marshalling tasks
• Act as technical reference
• Train new employees
• Provide operational backup when needed
Communication & Continuous Improvement:

• Report key issues to the Completion Manager
• Communicate effectively within the team
• Contribute to process improvements

Your profile:

• Secondary education or equivalent experience
• Knowledge of aircraft engine components
• Understanding of quality systems and processes
• ERP and IT proficiency
• Team management skills
• Awareness of logistics risks
• Able to manage priorities and urgent issues
• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements
• Working knowledge of French and English required
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 
 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.
 

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 

Your Role:
 

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 
 

Key Responsibilities:
 

Air Freight Administration
 

 
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
 
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
 
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities.  
 

Customer Service
 

 
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
 
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
 
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected.  
 

Compliance & Operational Excellence
 

 
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
 
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
 
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
 
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required.  
 

 
 

 

Your Profile:
 

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.
 

Requirements
 

 
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
 
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
 
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
 
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
 

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
 
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues. 
 

Personal Qualities
 

 
• Customer-focused and service-minded.
 
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
 
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
 
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
 
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your RoleAs a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your ProfileWe are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
